response.justification: Bogdan has strong software engineering and leadership experience, particularly in event-driven systems and real-time data processing (e.g., GISCollective, Dunnhumby). However, his resume lacks direct fintech or agentic-AI experience, which are core to the role. His recent work in MCP and AI-agent infrastructure is promising but not yet production-grade for the described fintech use case.
strengths: Extensive backend and distributed-systems expertise (Dunnhumby, re:cinq, GISCollective)
Proven track record scaling engineering teams and adopting modern development practices (RIDE Capital, Altom Consulting)
Strong hands-on technical depth across multiple languages and frameworks (TypeScript, D, Node.js, event-driven architectures)
concerns: No demonstrated experience in fintech infrastructure (credit systems, payment flows, embedded finance)
Limited direct exposure to agentic-AI systems in production (current work is early-stage or tooling-related)
Lacks regulatory/compliance experience in high-stakes financial environments
